name: Gabri
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1/5.2, languoid gabr1253 (Gabri) and sister pages toba1280 (Tobanga), kimr1241 (Kimré), kaba1292 (Kabalai).
sources.note: 8 references, none descriptive (overviews 1905-1990, Jungraithmayr 1977 comparative). Alternative names Gabere, Gaberi, Gabri-Nord, Ngabre, Northern/Southern Gabri.

sources.citation: OLAC combined catalogue, 'OLAC resources in and about the Gabri language' (gab), snapshot 2025-06-01.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Lists only Glottolog, Ethnologue, LINGUIST List and the SIL 1990 survey (oai:sil.org:47364). No description.

sources.citation: Newman, Paul. 2022. Comprehensive Bibliography of Chadic and Hausa Linguistics, 5th ed. Bloomington: IUScholarWorks. 282 pp. DOI 10.5967/5q3g-t220.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bibliography only. Entries keyworded 'E-C Gabri': Jungraithmayr 1977d (survey of the linguistic situation in the Chad 'Zweistromland', Gedenkschrift Nachtigal pp. 134-46) and Lukas 1937b Zentralsudanische Studien. No phonology, grammar or dictionary of Gabri (gab) or of Kimré is listed; Tobanga has Caprile 1975/1976/1978/1979; Kabalay has Hamm 2003 (SIL survey).

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Southern Gabri language' / 'Kimré language' / 'East Chadic languages'; Chadic Newsletter Online posts (2007 'Unpublished data and reports'; tag 'Gabri'; download page).
sources.note: No phonology anywhere; Chadic Newsletter's Gabri item is the Vanderkooi/Wagner/Nessiel 1990 survey.

sources.citation: Vanderkooi, Mark, Stephen Wagner & Nodjibogoto Nessiel. 1990 (Nov.). Rapport d'une enquête sociolinguistique entre le Gabri du Nord (Tobanga) et le Gabri du Sud (Dormo/Darbe). N'Djaména: SIL. 29 pp. (= Glottolog ref 98924, credited there to Vanderkooi, Chesley & Doun).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress or tone; intelligibility testing (recorded-text tests) and language-attitude interviews at Dormo and Darbé; bibliography lists only Caprile's Tobanga work and the earlier 1990 survey.

sources.citation: Vanderkooi, Mark, with William Chesley & Jean Doun. 1990 (14 Sept.). Rapport d'une enquête linguistique parmi les langues Gabri dans le sud du Tchad. N'Djaména: SIL / INSH. 16 pp. SIL archive item 47364.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Lexicostatistic survey of Gabri villages (Kimré, Délim, Bordo, Dormo, Darbé, Déressia, Tchéré-Aiba, Batoubo, Kaya). p.4 fn 6: tone not marked in the wordlists; p.2 §1.3: no research found on Kimré/Darbé/Dormo dialects; only Tobanga (Gabri-Nord) described by Caprile; cites an unobtainable ms Durand 1970 'Essai sur la langue et les coutumes de la race Gabri' (169 pp., Mission Catholique de Laï).

sources.citation: Bruel, Georges. 1905. Le cercle du Moyen-Logone. Paris: Comité de l'Afrique Française. 131 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Administrative/ethnographic; mentions the 'Gaberis' as a people only; no vocabulary, nothing on accent.

sources.citation: SIL Tchad / Mission Evangélique Unie, Gabri-Kimré Bible-translation project materials (orthography statement / phonology sketch), post-1990, if any exist.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The 1990 SIL report names a 'comité pour la traduction de la Bible dans le dialecte gabri-kimré'; such projects normally produce an orthography/phonology write-up, but none is catalogued in OLAC, SIL archives or Newman 2022 — existence unverified.

sources.citation: Caprile, Jean-Pierre. 1976. Eléments pour une orthographe pratique du tobanga. In Eléments pour une orthographe pratique des langues du Tchad, Annales de l'Université du Tchad, no. spécial, pp. 185-196; and Caprile 1978, Notes linguistiques sur le tobanga à partir d'un conte en cette langue, in Cinq textes tchadiques (Jungraithmayr & Caprile eds.), Berlin: Reimer, pp. 121-175.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: Nearest described variety: Tobanga = Gabri-Nord (toba1280, tng); the 1990 SIL lexicostatistics put Dormo/Darbé with Déressia (Tobanga). Would only serve with an explicit identity caveat, not as a Gabri (gab) statement.

sources.citation: Jungraithmayr, Herrmann. 1977. Die linguistische Situation im Zweistromland der Republik Tschad: Gustav Nachtigals Beobachtungen und heutiger Forschungsstand. In Gedenkschrift Gustav Nachtigal 1874-1974, ed. H. Ganslmayr & H. Jungraithmayr, pp. 134-146. Bremen: Übersee-Museum Bremen.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: Newman 2022 keywords it for Gabri; a research-situation survey that would name any further Gabri material (e.g. Jungraithmayr field notes), though unlikely to state a stress rule itself.

sources.citation: Durand, A. 1970. Essai sur la langue et les coutumes de la race Gabri. Manuscript, 169 pp. Laï, Tandjilé: Mission Catholique de Laï.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only substantial description of Southern Gabri named anywhere (SIL 1990 calls it 'un ouvrage très utile' but could not obtain it); a 169-page mission grammar would normally comment on accent/tone.

sources.citation: Lukas, Johannes. 1937. Zentralsudanische Studien. (Hansische Universität, Abhandlungen aus dem Gebiet der Auslandskunde 45.) Hamburg: Friederichsen, de Gruyter. 204 pp.

sources.note: Only published primary Gabri data before 1990 (1933 fieldwork; Newman 2022 keywords it E-C Gabri); Lukas's sketches of this era give word lists with grammatical notes and usually remark on Ton/Akzent.

sources.citation: Gaudefroy-Demombynes, Maurice. 1907. Documents sur les langues de l'Oubangui-Chari. In Actes du XIVe Congrès International des Orientalistes, Alger 1905, Part II, pp. 172-330. Paris: Ernest Leroux.

sources.note: Colonial-era vocabularies of the Logone region; may contain a note on accent for 'Gabri'. Gallica holds Partie 1 only and CAPTCHA-blocked our network; Part II not found on archive.org.

sources.citation: Caprile, Jean-Pierre. 1975 (with C. Seignobos) Esquisse de présentation du pays Tobanga ou 'Gabri-nord'; 1976 Eléments pour une orthographe pratique du tobanga (Annales Univ. du Tchad, no. spécial, pp. 185-196); 1978 Notes linguistiques sur le tobanga à partir d'un conte (in Cinq textes tchadiques, Berlin: Reimer, pp. 121-75).

sources.note: Describe Tobanga = Gabri-Nord (toba1280, ISO tng), a different Glottolog language; 1975 wordlist has tone marked (per Newman 2022 note). Not opened.
